Seen • Just now
Great question — getting started with Nurosym is simple. 
Apply a little moisture to the tragus (the small protrusion on your ear).
Clip the earpiece onto the left tragus, with the cable over and behind your ear.
Turn the device on and slowly increase the intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling.
Use it for 15–60 minutes per session, ideally daily (morning or split between morning and evening). 
You can read, work, meditate, or relax while using it.
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s recommended to speak with our clinical team before starting.
